title.zh-CN: 更稳定的完整扫描目录浏览

items.zh-CN: 修复完整扫描内容较多时，Users 等重要顶层文件夹偶尔无法打开或被归入“较小对象”的问题；这些目录现在会始终保留并可继续逐层浏览。
items.en: Fixed an issue where important top-level folders such as Users could become unavailable or be grouped under Smaller items in large Full Scan results. These folders now remain directly accessible for continued navigation.

items.zh-CN: 扫描在后台完成后，重新进入空间清理页面会自动加载最新结果，不再停留在空状态或要求重复扫描。
items.en: When a scan finishes in the background, reopening Space Cleanup now loads the latest result automatically instead of showing an empty state or requiring another scan.

items.zh-CN: 更新扫描结果时会保留最近一份可用结果；如果新结果暂时不可用，目录浏览仍可继续，不再突然提示目录索引缺失。
items.en: CoreRobin now keeps the most recent usable scan while results are updated, so folder navigation can continue if a newer result is temporarily unavailable instead of failing with a missing-index message.
